MATTHEVV.|69 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>to take any thing out of his house: {{verse|chapter=24|verse=18}}† and he that is in the field, let him not goe backe to take his coate. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=19}}† And vvo to thē that are vvith childe, and that giue sucke in those dayes. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=20}}† But pray that your flight be not in the vvinter or on the Sabboth. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=21}}† For there shal be then great tribulation, such as hath not been from the beginning of the vvorld vntil novv, neither shal be. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=22}}† And vnles those daies had been shortened, no flesh should be saued: but for the elect the daies ‖ shal be shortened. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=23}}† Then if any man shal say vnto you, Loe {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Whosoeuer draweth Christ or his Church from the Communion and felowship of al Nations Christened, to one corner, towne, or Countrie, beleeue him not. ''Aug. de vnit. Ec. c. 3''.}}∷ here is Christ, or there: do not beleeue him. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=24}}† For there shal rise false-Christes and false-Prophets, and shal shevv ‖ great signes and vvonders, so that the elect also (if it be possible) may be induced into errour. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=25}}† Loe I haue foretold you. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=26}}† If therfore they shal say vnto you, Behold he is in the desert: goe ye not out: behold ‖ in the closets, beleeue it not. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=27}}† For as lightening commeth out of the east, and appeareth euen into the vvest, so shal also the aduent of the sonne of man be. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=28}}† VVheresoeuer the body is, thither shal the egles also be gathered together.

{{verse|chapter=24|verse=29}}† And ‖ immediatly after the tribulation of those dayes {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ezech. 32, 7. Ioel 3, 15. Dan. 7, 15.''}}* the sonne shal be darkened, and the moone shal not giue her light, and the starres shal fal from heauen, and the powers of heauen shal be moued: {{verse|chapter=24|verse=30}}† and then shal appeare {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This signe of the Sonne of man, is the holy Crosse, which then shal appeare to the Iewes to their confusion. ''Chrys. in Mat. ho. 77''. It shal be no lesse confusion to Heretikes that can not abide the signe thereof.}}∷ the signe of the Sonne of man in heauen: and then shal al tribes of the earth bevvaile: and they shal see the Sonne of man comming in the cloudes of heauen vvith much povver and maiestie. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=31}}† And he shal send his Angels vvith a trumpet, and a great voyce: and they shal gather together his elect from the foure vvindes, from the furthest partes of heauen euen to the endes thereof. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=32}}† And of the figtree learne a parable: When novv the bough thereof is tender, and the leaues come forth, you know that sommer is nigh. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=33}}† So you also, vvhen you shal see these things, knovv ye that it is nigh euen at the doores. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=34}}† Amen I say to you, that this generation shal not passe, til al these things be done. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=35}}† Heauen and earth shal passe, but my vvordes shal not passe.⊣

{{verse|chapter=24|verse=36}}† But of that day and houre no body knovveth, neither the Angels of heauen, but the Father alone. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=37}}† And as {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 7, 5.''}}* in the dayes of Noe, so shal also the comming of the Sonne of man be. {{verse|chapter=24|verse=38}}† For as they vvere in the dayes before the floud, eating and drinking, marying and giuing to mariage, euen vnto that day in which Noe entred into the arke, {{verse|chapter=24|verse=39}}† and knevve not til<noinclude>{{rh||I iij|the}}</noinclude>
